newsitem.title: USA: MIA cargo up 13.9 percent in October.
newsitem.headline: MIA cargo up 13.9 percent in October.

text.p: Cargo shipped though Miami International Airport in October was up 13.9 percent over a year ago, statistics obtained from Dade County Aviation Department show.
"We are benefiting from the economic recovery in South America," Peter Reaveley, director of route development at MIA said.
"We are projecting a strong November and December," he said.
Total cargo, including mail, amounted to 179,726 tons in October, nearly 14 percent more than MIA handled in October of 1995, the Dade County statistics show.
The gains were led by international cargo, which totaled 144,798 tons, a 14.6 percent jump over the same month in 1995.
Domestic cargo was 43,928 tons, up 11.32 percent over the year earlier month. -- Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
